name: T-R1_half
why: Backward loop G=r+γG. A forward-order bug would give [1, 1.5, 1.75].

name: T-R1_cartpole_gamma
why: CartPole γ=0.95 hand-computed return-to-go on [1,1,1].

name: T-R1_pong_reset
why: Point-boundary reset: later +1 must not leak into the earlier −1.

name: T-R1_pong_noleak_contrast
why: Without reset, the −1 point still contains later points (the leak D2 avoids).

name: T-R4_adam_first_step
expected: ±0.01 on nonzero grads, 0 on zero grad
why: Explains why Adam hides gradient-scale differences between baseline arms.

name: T-R5_nan_guard
expected: finite loss and grads; length-1 skips standardization
why: std(unbiased=False)+1e-8; length-1 would be 0/0 without the skip.

name: T-R2_weighted_matches_true_grad
expected: every component of the N=200k mean within 4 SE of ∇J
why: w_t=γ^t is the exact gradient of J=E[r0+γ r1].

name: T-R2_unweighted_matches_its_expectation
why: The w_t=1 estimator is unbiased for a different (state-distribution) objective.

name: T-R2_unweighted_differs_from_true_grad
expected: differs from true ∇J by >10 SE in at least one component
why: With γ=0.5 the unweighted step-2 term is off by a factor of 2 (1/γ).

name: T-R2_J_value
why: Reference value of the toy objective at the fixed θ (seed 0, std 0.5).

name: T-R3_bandit_closed_form
why: Closed-form softmax bandit; catches a missing (e_a−π) or a flipped sign.

name: T-B1_unbiasedness
expected: all three means within 4 SE of ∇J (N=200k, +10 reward offset)
why: Action-independent baselines do not change the expected gradient.

name: T-B1_var_zero_gt_J
why: A constant baseline equal to J reduces variance vs b=0.

name: T-B1_var_J_gt_V
why: The optimal state-value baseline should beat the best constant.

name: T-B2_bstar_at_half
why: At a uniform policy the optimal constant baseline equals the mean reward.

name: T-B2_rare_action_weight
why: For skewed π=0.9/0.1, b* weights the rarer action ≈9× more.

name: T-B2_variance_ordering
why: Closed-form variances of the 2-action softmax bandit estimator.

name: T-B3_zero_value_equals_no_baseline
why: A identically-zero baseline must not change the policy gradient.

name: T-B3_no_value_grad_from_policy_loss
expected: value-net grad is None or all-zero after policy backward
why: baseline_values are detached inside reinforce_loss.

name: T-B3_value_loss_leaves_policy_grad
measured: policy grads identical after value MSE backward
why: Separate graphs: value MSE must not write into policy.grad.

name: T-B4_ema_previous_only
why: EMA must not include the current episode's own returns.

name: T-B6_same_G_target
measured: ValueBaseline.update receives the same G_t tensor the policy loss used
why: Advantage mean ≈ 0 is reported at eval time for a fitted baseline.

name: T-C1_term_vs_trunc
measured: lengths=[500, 500, 500, 500, 500] flags=[(True, False, 'time-limit'), (True, False, 'time-limit'), (True, False, 'time-limit'), (True, False, 'time-limit'), (True, False, 'time-limit')]
expected: every episode length 500, truncated=True, terminated=False, cause=time-limit
why: Removing the failure thresholds leaves only the 500-step time limit.

name: T-C2_random_policy_anchor
why: Untrained net must look like a random agent before we claim learning.

name: T-C3_initial_policy
why: Tiny last-layer init keeps the start near-uniform.

name: T-C4_same_seed_same_traj
expected: identical obs/actions/rewards for the first episode
why: Per-episode generator + env.reset(seed=) must replay.

name: T-C4_10step_trace
expected: table of (t, obs, probs, action, reward, G_t, logπ)
why: Isolating the first 10 steps is the assignment's requested evidence.

name: T-C4_three_updates_bit_identical
why: Catches hidden RNG leaks (global torch seed, Adam state, numpy).

name: T-C4_omitting_zero_grad_changes_params
expected: parameters differ when zero_grad is omitted
why: Proves the determinism test is not a tautology: a real bug is detectable.

name: T-C5_bookkeeping
expected: equal lengths at every update; buffers empty after the step
why: A dropped last transition would silently bias G_t and the loss.

name: T-C7_sum_loss_corr
why: Longer episodes contribute more terms; the sum loss preserves that.

name: T-C7_mean_loss_corr
why: Mean-over-t cancels the length signal, which is why we do not use it.

name: T-P1_actions_in_2_3
why: The network never emits NOOP/FIRE; only RIGHT/LEFT reach ALE.

name: T-P1_forced_logits
why: Index 0 is RIGHT = ALE action 2.

name: T-P2_paddle_control
measured: visible=True travel_2=28.5px travel_3=77.5px delta2=-11.00 delta3=63.10 opposite=True cols=(68, 74)
expected: centroid moves ≥5 px one way then ≥5 px the opposite way; paddle visible
why: Confirms preprocess keeps the agent paddle and the action map actually steers it.

name: T-P3_copy_safe
why: The assignment slices are views; we copy first so we do not mutate ALE's frame.

name: T-P3_shape_and_values
why: Matches the given preprocess spec.

name: T-P3_diff_and_first_zero
expected: first diff all 0; diffs ⊆ {-1,0,1}; min nonzero pixels > 0; ≥50% diffs nonzero after step 20
why: First-frame convention + ball motion. A dead preprocess would be all zeros.

name: T-P4_initial_policy
why: Must hold before any multi-hour Pong run; otherwise the init is peaked.

name: T-P5_random_anchor
why: Learning is claimed only if MA100 rises by >0.3 (≥3 SE) and stays there.

name: T-P9_scripted_ball_tracker
why: Validates frames + action mapping. Naive chase scored -21; intercept + deadband is the controller under test (D19).

name: T-P10_resume
measured: n1=3 n2=5 ep_done=5 dup=False params_changed=True rc=0
expected: episode counter continues to 5, no duplicated CSV rows, params not reset
why: A resume that silently restarts would double-count and poison the curve.

name: T-P6_worker_learner_logp
why: Proves identical weights were used (on-policy) and the index/action map agrees.

name: T-P7_point_boundary_synthetic
expected: returns at ±1 equal ±1; earlier steps of a point ignore later points
why: Same logic as T-R1, applied to a Pong-like reward stream.

name: T-P7_point_boundary_real_episode
expected: G_t = r_t at every point-scoring step
why: On a real Pong episode, later points do not leak into earlier G_t.

name: T-P8_determinism_default
expected: identical first-50-frame hashes if ALE is deterministic; else document and skip
why: Default Pong-v5 has sticky-action probability 0.25, so this often fails — that is expected.
